rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); inline encoded image bytes (an ImageView data:image source, a SceneImage blob) decoded and uploaded a fresh texture on every Skia paint. Canvas gains draw_image_from_keyed_data[_rect] taking a SHA-256 content key; the base forwards to the unkeyed draw so CoreGraphics and recording backends are unchanged, and SkiaCanvas reuses ImageFileCache under a NUL-prefixed inline-sha256 key scoped by backend, never by buffer address. Cached frames are pixel-identical to uncached ones. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, packaging, or source-authority boundary moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'Disabling the image cache rebuilds keyed inline bytes'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'ImageView data URI decodes once across Graphite paints'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'Recording canvas records keyed inline bytes'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SceneImage encoded bytes decode once across Graphite paints'
